principle: posterior labels are reporting conventions, not data-dependent model-selection triggers

directional_label_rule.supported: P(Delta > 0 | data) >= 0.95 under BOTH registered priors
directional_label_rule.contradicted: P(Delta < 0 | data) >= 0.95 under BOTH registered priors

cross_universe_generality_requires: frozen pre-outcome marginal timing support gate passes
frozen per-universe target-outcome support gate passes
U2 Delta_T directional label = supported under both priors
U6 Delta_T directional label = supported under both priors
no practically large contradictory U6 x ORDERED interaction

interaction_rule.contradictory_if: P(gamma_u6_ordered_nonstructural < -1.0 | data) >= 0.95 under EITHER registered prior
interaction_rule.acceptable_for_generality_if: contradictory criterion is false under BOTH registered priors

prohibitions: do not call a hypothesis supported from posterior mean sign alone
do not change the 0.95 probability threshold after seeing results
do not reactivate BALANCE from a pooled Delta_T label alone
do not use a supported H_M as cross-universe replication
do not drop a contradicted or inconclusive result from reporting
